title: InferenceGuard Receipt
description: Receipt written by InferenceGuard on every execution — activation or non-activation. Required by I10.

activated.description: True if InferenceGuard ran transforms on input. False on non-activation.

reason.description: Required when activated is false. Explains why module did not activate.

gateway_condition.description: Which activation condition triggered: gateway-security or task_type match.

task_type.description: task_type from the task card at time of activation check.

tier_applied.description: Trigger tier active for this execution.

triggers_detected.description: List of trigger terms detected in input.

inference_refusal.description: Set true if a PoC generation or transform attempt was refused or truncated. Used by Red protocol for inference_guard_summary.

input_length_before.description: Character count of input before transforms.

input_length_after.description: Character count of input after transforms.
